speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked	the Minister for National Development whether NParks will consider installing more toilets along the park connectors.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Can I ask the Senior Minister of State is it possible to share what are the criteria for deciding whether to install a toilet in the parks, small or bigger parks, along the Park Connectors?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: There will be signs to direct users to the nearest available toilets located at places such as nearby parks, food centres and shopping malls.
